meta.name: color-theory
meta.description: Color theory principles for art education. Covers the three color properties (hue, saturation, value), color mixing systems (subtractive and additive), color relationships (complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary), color temperature, simultaneous contrast and the relativity of color perception, and practical palette construction. Use when analyzing color in artworks, planning color schemes, understanding optical phenomena in painting, or investigating Albers's Interaction of Color experiments.

copy.tagline: 分析艺术作品中的色彩关系与配色方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统理解色彩理论并应用于艺术教育或创作实践。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze color relationships and schemes in artworks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically understand color theory for art education or creative practice.
